notes: Bespoke promo/discount banner (Section / Promo Banner / Desktop). Centered single-column layout: a bordered 'Discount Code' pill (label + dark code-box with light code text 'ARISTOPADRES'), an overline eyebrow in primary/accent #af7d4f, an H2 (Instrument Sans Bold 52), a fine-print disclaimer, and two CTA buttons. Primary button = filled foreground-heading bg (#1e1b18) with background-colored text; secondary button = transparent bg + border using secondary-button/text (#1e1b18). multiScheme=true: essential/background resolves to #ede8e1 in get_variable_defs but the design-context inline default for the section bg and the primary-button text is #99ddd7 (teal), indicating the same variable maps to a different scheme in this section context vs the file default. radius/button_primary and radius/button_secondary both 0 (square buttons). Two button atoms are library instances of Button (node 21:10, Style Primary/Secondary x State Default/Hover). Only the Desktop variant was inspected; no repeated child blocks. No carousel/sticky/marquee behavior observed.
